rulings.rationale: Concurrent discounts and subsidized delivery intensify competition for buyers and scarce delivery teams; the size of the effect is a teaching assumption

chain.claim: The home pilot starts with twenty qualified delivery teams
The incumbent can sustain a fee reduction across this move
New enterprise accounts cannot complete review within the first eight-month move
Competition for existing accounts and delivery talent leaves eighteen home teams available

outcome.description: Competition modestly reduces home delivery capacity while new enterprise demand is delayed
